The rumour itself is that the seat count for Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines may change to 165. I'll keep it to this DM. I won't bring it up with anyone else or in any channel, even if Pree asks me to later, unless everyone there could already see it.

One correction to my reply: I told Pree to "just tell me where" if she wants it shared once it's confirmed. That goes further than I should, since her asking isn't enough for me to repeat it. If it comes up again, I'll say that it's best for her to share it herself or wait until it's somewhere the people in that channel can already see.
